graphql.query:
query GetGoalProgress($goalId: String!) {
  goalProgress(goalId: $goalId) {
    goalId
    goalName
    targetAmount
    currentAmount
    remainingAmount
    progressPercentage
    daysRemaining
    averageMonthlyContribution
    requiredMonthlyContribution
    isOnTrack
  }
}
